candidates.text: When authoring scope.json in Discovery, write every in_scope entry as a bare repository-relative path (e.g. 'demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py') and put any narrowing such as 'classify_credit_score only' into constraints or out_of_scope. engineer.md Step 1d matches in_scope by exact string equality, validate_scope does not reject annotated entries, and a promoted scope.json cannot be corrected inside the same run, so one annotation costs the whole run at Implementation.
